name: Sticky
text: Sticks to the first creature it lands by and rides it into its pack before it blows.
vfx: the grenade rides on a creature's back, blinking, then blows
art_prompt: a grenade coated in dripping yellow glue with a suction pad

A.note: the grenade's: a glossy amber grenade with a blinking light

B.note: B · the stick keeps its own paper and its spark (no amber tint, no blinking light); the icon in amber resin

recipe.subject: The reference image shows the stick of dynamite to draw: keep its shape, parts and colours. A sandy-brown paper stick of dynamite with dark rings and cream ends sealed inside a thick blob of glossy translucent golden amber resin: the amber coats the whole stick with a shiny highlight, the stick showing through it, fat amber drips hanging off its underside, the fuse sticking out of the amber with the fuse lit: a big bright yellow and orange spark burst fizzing at its tip with a few tiny sparks flying off, easy to see, plain paper with no letters, numbers or writing anywhere on it, lying diagonally
